sm.description: Maximum container width at small breakpoint (540px). Container width for landscape phones and small tablets.

md.description: Maximum container width at medium breakpoint (720px). Container width optimized for tablets.

lg.description: Maximum container width at large breakpoint (960px). Standard desktop container width.

xl.description: Maximum container width at extra large breakpoint (1140px). Wide desktop container width.

xxl.description: Maximum container width at extra extra large breakpoint (1320px). Widest container for ultra-wide displays.

padding-x.description: Horizontal padding for containers (12px left and right). Applied by the make-container mixin for content spacing.
